input.prompt: I'd like Research Work to recheck the numbers another study reports: whether a mean, a percentage or an SD is even possible for its sample size, and whether a p value follows from its test statistic. Can you add that?

required: the tail probabilities match their closed forms and the textbook critical values
a reported p is compared with the range the rounded statistic allows
GRIM: a mean must be a whole total divided by n, and large samples are not checked
GRIMMER: the SD must come from a whole sum of squares of the right parity
DEBIT: a proportion's SD follows from the proportion and n
a Recheck Table's Status is written by the computation, and a hand-written status is refused
GRIMMER is exact: an SD passes only when whole numbers with that total and sum of squares exist
one-tailed wordings in common use are read, and two-tailed or non-directional ones are not
thousands separators are one number in n and in degrees of freedom
a row with two results, or a count that is not a whole number above zero, is not computable
recheck --write puts the Status in its own column, and an unchecked row fails and loses its typed status
view recover gives the resume view, each source with its trigger and size, and live Git state
view recover reports a record naming another branch and a commit HEAD does not have
validate warns on unresolved pointers, fails on them only with --strict, and lists outside ones
